title: DOQS role declaration
description: The [role] table of an okh.toml in a machine repository. A role is a job the machine needs doing -- 'the X-axis linear guide' -- named after the job and never after the product bought, so changing brand moves nothing above it. It generates no files: a library update cannot substitute a different part number, so there is nothing to copy and protect against. See docs/roles.md.

library.description: Repository-root-relative path of the mounted parts library, e.g. modules/stoq.

selected.description: What you buy today: family path inside the library, then '#', then the brand's own part number.

approved.description: Parts checked against this role's requirements and found acceptable, including the selected one. Optional, and the place engineering judgement gets written down instead of living in somebody's memory.
